596382.Description:
When this card would be played, reduce the play cost by 3 for each of your opponent's Digimon and Tamers.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [De-Digivolve 1] all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete all of their level 4 or lower Digimon.
[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.

If it's of that category, this Digimon isn't affected by that category's effects, other than this Digimon's effects, for the turn.
